item.title: 🟠 Unpatched XRING Flaw in XQUIC Lets Remote Clients Crash HTTP/3 Servers
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
A single wrong variable on one line in XQUIC, Alibaba's QUIC and HTTP/3 library, lets any remote client crash the server with a short burst of completely legal traffic. There is no patch. Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1h ago

item.title: 🟠 Attackers Exploit 'Ill Bloom' Vulnerability to Drain $3.1 Million From Cryptocurrency Wallets
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Security firm Coinspect has disclosed a crypto wallet flaw it calls Ill Bloom, and attackers are already using it. The flaw is in how some wallet software generated its recovery phrase, the words that control the money.
